## Summary

Follow-up feature (deferred from SA-0MSK9IOEF007PP5S per operator decision — we want to use local models as much as possible and there is no hardware for multiple local models; revisit when a fast local model is available).

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `model.audit_phase1` config option is resolved via existing config resolution, falling back to `model.audit` (full model) when absent.
2. Phase 1 parent + child AC screening calls use the fast model; Phase 2 deep analysis keeps the full model.
3. Phase 1 per-call wall-clock target < 60s on a healthy proxy (baseline: 1,348s avg, max 2,400s).
4. Config flag default is safe: if the fast model cannot produce reliable batched verdict JSON, it falls back to the full model for Phase 1.
5. Unit tests cover config resolution, fallback, and per-phase model threading.
6. SKILL.md documents the tiered-model flags and defaults.
